items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a two-line guard, e.g. `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`. It reuses the existing field-cache API, matches the surrounding style and reads clearly. The code comments above each loop still describe what it does.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The same small guard is applied consistently in three descriptor `get_prefetch_queryset` loops using the existing `is_cached`/`set_cached_value` helpers. It adds no new bookkeeping or helpers, and the agent removed its scratch directory. The added test follows the existing test patterns.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The guard only skips overwriting a relation that is already cached and changes no error paths. Plain prefetches still fill the reverse cache. The hidden tests passed (F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85).

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path in `create_reverse_many_to_one_manager` is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`. `ReverseOneToOneDescriptor` is guarded the same way and the forward FK path too. The parent is still assigned when nothing is cached. The new test covers the one-to-one and FK cases.
